metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Fix a Pinched Nerve in Your Neck
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly relieve sharp, shooting pains in the neck (including those that travel into the shoulder and arm) caused by a pinched nerve.

These exercises are especially effective for pinched nerves resulting from a bulging or herniated disc in the neck (a common cause), as well as from muscle spasms.

For best results, go through all of the exercises and continue with the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now to get instant pinched nerve pain relief at home!
